title: Gemma, elephant-1 and the two together on the gold jobs
compared: The production Gemma, elephant-1 on its own, and a hybrid that takes elephant-1's class when it is sure and Gemma's otherwise.
sample: The 95 public gold jobs Gemma answered: failed jobs whose bug or ticket a person set.

rows.approach: elephant-1 if its probability is 0.6 or more, else Gemma

verdict: Gemma 50, elephant-1 42, hybrid 48 of 95. elephant-1 called 26 jobs infrastructure, and the gold set has none. No gain.
note: The gold jobs hold only product bugs and test issues, so every infrastructure answer is wrong.
